display_long_description:
Welcome to Cuss Tag, a chaotic and unpredictable tag game where the only real rule is to have fun. In this crazy world, players run, chase, hide, and tag each other while exploring a map full of surprises. Every round is different, and anything can happen once the game begins.

The goal is simple: avoid getting tagged while trying to tag others when it’s your turn. But Cuss Tag isn’t just a normal game of tag. The environment is full of places to explore, objects to interact with, and plenty of opportunities to create hilarious moments with other players. You can run across the map, hide from the tagger, mess around with friends, or just enjoy the chaos happening around you.

Because players can do almost whatever they want, the game often turns into funny and unexpected situations. One moment you might be running for your life, and the next moment you’re laughing with friends as everyone tries to escape the tagger. The unpredictable gameplay keeps every round exciting and different.

Whether you want to compete, explore, or just hang out and have fun, Cuss Tag gives you the freedom to play your own way. Jump into the chaos, challenge other players, and see how long you can survive without getting tagged.

Run fast, stay alert, and most importantly… don’t get tagged!
